RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias. For a senior position like Head of Risk Modelling, executive leadership and regulatory affairs experience (e.g., managing regulatory scrutiny, model governance, and compliance) are often prioritized over technical or statistical depth. Questioning the decision based solely on the panel's gender would appear speculative and could severely damage your professional reputation in a specialized market.

Delays in post-interview feedback are common due to administrative backlogs or finalizing offers. Rather than alleging discrimination, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen future candidacies. Consider legal counsel only if concrete, objective evidence of bias emerges.
